svg.title: Prisma Compute vs Vercel Pricing
svg.desc: The same 20M-request month: about $236 on Vercel (Pro), crossed out, becomes about $98 on Prisma Compute at planned rates, saving about $138 or 58% every month.

g.text: One month, priced line by line: 20M requests, 300 vCPU-hours, 2 TB egress, one seat.
